jam.sentenceEn: Traffic jams are a common problem of most big cities, either in developed or in developing countries, but one kind of traffic jams in particular can be especially frustrating.
jam.translationZh: 无论是发达国家还是发展中国家，交通拥堵都是大多数大城市的常见问题，但有一种交通拥堵尤其令人沮丧。

jam.sentenceEn: A video from the project shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control; they eventually back up in phantom jams .
jam.translationZh: 该项目的一段视频显示，一列自主机器人沿着轨道运行，没有进行双边控制；它们最终在幽灵拥堵中后退。

jam.sentenceEn: A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly, which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave, getting worse the farther it spreads.
jam.translationZh: 幽灵堵车始于拥堵车流中的一辆车轻微减速，这导致其后方车辆减速更甚——这种减速行为像波浪一样在车道中向后传播，传播得越远，拥堵就越严重。

jam.sentenceEn: Such modifications, Horn said, could help fight phantom jams within a few years, maybe decades before an alternative solution, such as networked self-driving cars, becomes a reality on the roads.
jam.translationZh: 霍恩表示，这类改进可能在几年内帮助缓解幽灵堵车问题，比联网自动驾驶汽车等替代解决方案真正上路要早几十年。

jam.sentenceEn: Increasing the spacing of vehicles dampens the effect of slowdowns by cars in front of a given car, so that the slowing is not worsened until it becomes a phantom jam , the researchers said.
jam.translationZh: 研究人员表示，增加车辆之间的间距可以减轻前方车辆减速对当前车辆的影响，从而延缓减速加剧直至形成幽灵堵车的过程。

jam.sentenceEn: Drivers caught up in phantom traffic jams are likely to think an accident has happened or some construction is going on.
jam.translationZh: 陷入幽灵堵车的司机们很可能会以为发生了事故或者正在进行道路施工。

journal.sentenceEn: For their study—outlined in a paper in the journal Conservation Biology—the team looked at genetic diversity and spread among a Chinese panda population.
journal.translationZh: 在《保护生物学》期刊发表的一篇论文中，研究团队概述了他们的研究，该研究关注中国大熊猫种群的遗传多样性及分布情况。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

journal.sentenceEn: New research by Horn and MIT postdoctoral associate Liang Wang, published in the journal IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, shows how bilateral control can fight the problem.
journal.translationZh: 霍恩与麻省理工学院博士后研究员王亮发表在《IEEE智能交通系统汇刊》上的最新研究，展示了双边控制如何解决这一问题。

journal.sentenceEn: According to a recently published study in The Journal of Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease, the part of your brain responsible for ASMR doesn't get lost to Alzheimer's.
journal.translationZh: 《阿尔茨海默病预防杂志》最近发表的一项研究显示，大脑中负责自发性知觉经络反应（ASMR）的区域并不会因阿尔茨海默病而丧失功能。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

journal.sentenceEn: While genes can encourage an interest in doing new things, a 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging found completing reasoning tasks like puzzles and number games can enhance that desire for novel experiences, which can, in turn, refresh the brain.
journal.translationZh: 虽然基因可能会激发人们尝试新事物的兴趣，但2012年发表在《心理学与老龄化》期刊上的一项研究发现，完成拼图和数字游戏等推理任务可以增强这种对新奇体验的渴望，进而让大脑焕然一新。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

journal.sentenceEn: Exercising for just 10 minutes a week is linked to a longer life, according to a new study published in The British Journal of Sports Medicine.
journal.translationZh: 《英国运动医学杂志》发表的一项新研究表明，每周仅锻炼10分钟就与更长的寿命有关联。
journal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

journal.sentenceEn: What is the finding of the 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging?
journal.translationZh: 2012年发表在《心理学与衰老》期刊上的研究有什么发现？

journey.sentenceEn: This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
journey.translationZh: 由此开启了一段转型之旅，我们开始改变教学实践，并挑战一群六年级学生的学习方式，而这些学生多年来早已习惯了坐在成排的课桌前学习。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: I was surprised that the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey and avoiding sleeping on the plane.
journey.translationZh: 令我惊讶的是，专家竟然建议在整个航程中禁食，并避免在飞机上睡觉。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

journey.sentenceEn: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom.
journey.translationZh: 有人说，衰老与其说是通向智慧的旅程，不如说是滑向健忘的过程。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: Indeed, the latest research that has emerged on language and aging shows that language mastery is a journey that we begin as infants and continue on for the rest of our lives.
journey.translationZh: 事实上，最新的语言与衰老研究表明，语言掌握是一段始于婴儿时期并贯穿余生的旅程。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

journey.sentenceEn: The journey was only recently confirmed by authorities.
journey.translationZh: 这一行程直到最近才得到当局证实。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

journey.sentenceEn: The journey took place in February when temperatures average negative 26 degrees Celsius.
journey.translationZh: 这段旅程发生在2月份，当时的平均气温为零下26摄氏度。
journey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

judge.sentenceEn: Another is television presenter and interior designer Naomi Cleaver, who is one of the competition's judges .
judge.translationZh: 另一位是电视节目主持人兼室内设计师娜奥米·克利弗，她是该比赛的评委之一。

judge.sentenceEn: "And the judging day is terrific fun.
judge.translationZh: 而评审日真的非常有趣。

judge.sentenceEn: Hourican and his pupils have happy memories of spending a whole day at the museum, having been selected as one of 10 shortlisted schools to present their idea to a panel of judges , including designer Jasper Conran.
judge.translationZh: 胡里肯和他的学生们对在博物馆度过一整天有着愉快的回忆，他们的学校被选为10所入围学校之一，向包括设计师贾斯珀·康兰在内的评委团展示自己的想法。

judge.sentenceEn: Unlike bats, birds and fish, however, humans have difficulty judging distances behind them.
judge.translationZh: 然而，与蝙蝠、鸟类和鱼类不同，人类很难判断身后的距离。

judge.sentenceEn: One of Design Ventura's judges says the competition adds vigour to the standard curriculum in schools.
judge.translationZh: “文图拉设计大赛”的一位评委表示，该竞赛为学校的标准课程增添了活力。

judge.sentenceEn: They tended to be arbitrarily judged by individuals of opposing groups.
judge.translationZh: 他们往往会受到来自其他群体成员更严厉的评判。

junk.sentenceEn: Junk food is now a staple of many Americans' diets.
junk.translationZh: 垃圾食品现在已成为许多美国人饮食中的主食。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

junk.sentenceEn: Interventions(干预) to help reduce junk food consumption are especially important for children and teenagers.
junk.translationZh: 旨在减少垃圾食品摄入的干预措施对儿童和青少年尤为重要。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

junk.sentenceEn: It revealed a secret about the manipulative and deceptive strategies used to make junk food more addictive and characterize the products as healthy.
junk.translationZh: 它揭示了一个秘密，即通过操纵和欺骗性策略，使垃圾食品更让人上瘾，并将其产品包装成健康食品。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

junk.sentenceEn: Then, when I was tired and hungry, I'd use my phone to order food, like burgers and other junk , instead of going to the canteen, where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
junk.translationZh: 后来，当我又累又饿的时候，我就用手机点外卖，比如汉堡之类的垃圾食品，而不是去食堂——在那里我能用一半的价钱吃到更健康的饭菜。
junk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

junk.sentenceEn: What is a major flaw in previous interventions to help reduce junk food consumption?
junk.translationZh: 以往减少垃圾食品消费的干预措施存在哪些主要缺陷？

junk.sentenceEn: They motivated teens to stay away from junk food only temporarily.
junk.translationZh: 他们仅仅是暂时激励了青少年远离垃圾食品。

justice.sentenceEn: The arrests were in connection with a string of mail thefts from U.S. Postal Service's collection boxes in Marion County and for the possession of a stolen postal key, according to the Department of Justice .
justice.translationZh: 美国司法部表示，这些逮捕行动与马里恩县发生的一系列美国邮政局邮箱盗窃案有关，同时也涉及持有被盗的邮政钥匙。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

justice.sentenceEn: In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice .
justice.translationZh: 相比之下，这项新干预措施巧妙地利用了青少年反叛、自主的天性，以及他们对社会正义的重视。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

justice.sentenceEn: After the intervention, participants associated healthy eating with autonomy and social justice .
justice.translationZh: 干预结束后，参与者将健康饮食与自主权及社会正义联系在了一起。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

justice.sentenceEn: Words that were more difficult to visualize, for example, " justice " or "morality" were considered to be more abstract.
justice.translationZh: 例如，像“正义”或“道德”这类更难可视化的词汇被认为更抽象。
justice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

justice.sentenceEn: In pursuit of revealing this complicated reality, Mothering Justice , led by women of color, went last year to the state capital in Lansing, Michigan, to lobby on issues that affect working mothers.
justice.translationZh: 为了揭示这一复杂现实，由有色人种女性领导的“母亲正义”组织去年前往密歇根州首府兰辛，就影响职业母亲的相关议题进行游说。

justice.sentenceEn: In this case, the Mothering Justice activist happened to be married.
justice.translationZh: 而在这个案例中，这位“母亲正义”组织的活动家恰恰是已婚人士。

jamming.sentenceEn: Wireless security providers will often take steps to help combat the threat of jamming attacks.
jamming.translationZh: 无线安全系统提供商通常会采取措施来帮助应对信号干扰攻击的威胁。
干扰攻击是绝对可能发生的。

jamming.sentenceEn: It's easier to find and acquire jamming equipment for some frequencies than it is for others.
jamming.translationZh: 对于某些频率，找到并获取干扰设备比其他频率更容易。

jamming.sentenceEn: SimpliSafe was singled out in one recent article on jamming , complete with a video showing the entire system being effectively bypassed with hand-held jamming equipment.
jamming.translationZh: SimpliSafe在最近一篇关于信号干扰的文章中被单独提及，文中还配有一段视频，展示了有人使用手持干扰设备成功绕过整个系统的过程。

jamming.sentenceEn: Jamming concerns are nothing new, and they're not unique to security systems.
jamming.translationZh: 对信号干扰的担忧并非新鲜事，也并非仅限于安防系统。

jamming.sentenceEn: SimpliSafe provides devices that are able to distinguish incidental radio interference from targeted jamming attacks.
jamming.translationZh: SimpliSafe提供的设备能够区分偶然的无线电干扰和有针对性的干扰攻击。
